AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Provides functions for controlling internet radio playback and managing radio stations. Operational Patterns: - Use searchStations to find radio stations when the user requests a station by name or genre. - Use playStation to start playback of a selected station. - Use getPlaybackState to determine the current playback status. - Use getCurrentStation to retrieve the currently playing station. - Use playNextStation and playPreviousStation to navigate between stations. - Use getSavedStations to retrieve the user's saved radio stations. - Use getFavoriteStations to retrieve favorite radio stations. - Use playStationByUuid when a valid station UUID is available.
Constraints: - Only use station UUIDs returned by the app or obtained from its saved station data. - Do not claim playback started unless the function confirms success. - Do not invent station names, stream URLs, or playback states. - Respect the user's explicit playback commands.
